'''Pret Swain''' was the manager of the [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]-based [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]], a manufacturer of illegal and semi-legal technology. Swain's parents, both of whom were [[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]] [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]], were killed in the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Swain was visiting his uncles, [[Vance Caelli]] and [[Rondale Merced]] on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] at the time, and they offered him a position at Caelli-Merced. Swain took over the business after his uncles mysteriously disappeared.<ref name="BSS" />

Due to the disappearance of his uncles, Swain became paranoid and lied underground in a fortress under [[Cjaalysce'I]]. He was protected by his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] friend and [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Kuykenda]]. Swain approached [[Saadoon-Kauldi]] and offered to sell him a very cheap [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] that could be used as a mobile, secure habitat. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was named ''[[Merkel]]'', a customized [[Action V transport]] from [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] adapted to Saadoon-Kauldi's specific needs.<ref name="BSS" />
